title: Spanish from Spain
tutor: Spanish from Spain (use vosotros where relevant, and Spain vocabulary like "vale")

roadmap.title: Getting around
roadmap.can: Ask directions, buy tickets, understand recto and a la izquierda

roadmap.title: Hostels and shopping
roadmap.can: Use hay and tener, ask for what you need, compare prices

roadmap.title: Likes, wants and plans
roadmap.can: Use gustar, querer, apetecer and ir a + infinitive

roadmap.title: Daily routine
roadmap.can: Describe your day with reflexive verbs: levantarse, ducharse

roadmap.title: Irregular favourites
roadmap.can: Master ir, hacer, tener, poder and querer

roadmap.title: What happened
roadmap.can: Tell a short story with the pretérito perfecto: he perdido, he comido

roadmap.title: A2 checkpoint
roadmap.can: Hold a full conversation with a stranger, then check your level
